   623  /-! ### Bounded convergence results for finite measures

   625  This section is about bounded convergence theorems for finite measures.

   631  /-- A bounded convergence theorem for a finite measure:
   632  If a sequence of bounded continuous non-negative functions are uniformly bounded by a constant
   633  and tend pointwise to a limit, then their integrals (`MeasureTheory.lintegral`) against the finite
   634  measure tend to the integral of the limit.
   635  
   636  A related result with more general assumptions is
   637  `MeasureTheory.tendsto_lintegral_nn_filter_of_le_const`.
   638  -/
   639  theorem tendsto_lintegral_nn_of_le_const (μ : FiniteMeasure Ω) {fs : ℕ → Ω →ᵇ ℝ≥0} {c : ℝ≥0}
   640      (fs_le_const : ∀ n ω, fs n ω ≤ c) {f : Ω → ℝ≥0}
   641      (fs_lim : ∀ ω, Tendsto (fun n ↦ fs n ω) atTop (𝓝 (f ω))) :
   642      Tendsto (fun n ↦ ∫⁻ ω, fs n ω ∂(μ : Measure Ω)) atTop (𝓝 (∫⁻ ω, f ω ∂(μ : Measure Ω))) :=
   643    tendsto_lintegral_nn_filter_of_le_const μ
   644      (.of_forall fun n ↦ .of_forall (fs_le_const n))
   645      (.of_forall fs_lim)
   646  
   647  /-- A bounded convergence theorem for a finite measure:
   648  If bounded continuous non-negative functions are uniformly bounded by a constant and tend to a
   649  limit, then their integrals against the finite measure tend to the integral of the limit.
   650  This formulation assumes:
   651  * the functions tend to a limit along a countably generated filter;
   652  * the limit is in the almost everywhere sense;
   653  * boundedness holds almost everywhere;
   654  * integration is the pairing against non-negative continuous test functions
   655    (`MeasureTheory.FiniteMeasure.testAgainstNN`).
   656  
   657  A related result using `MeasureTheory.lintegral` for integration is
   658  `MeasureTheory.FiniteMeasure.tendsto_lintegral_nn_filter_of_le_const`.
   659  -/
   660  theorem tendsto_testAgainstNN_filter_of_le_const {ι : Type*} {L : Filter ι}
   661      [L.IsCountablyGenerated] {μ : FiniteMeasure Ω} {fs : ι → Ω →ᵇ ℝ≥0} {c : ℝ≥0}
   662      (fs_le_const : ∀ᶠ i in L, ∀ᵐ ω : Ω ∂(μ : Measure Ω), fs i ω ≤ c) {f : Ω →ᵇ ℝ≥0}
   663      (fs_lim : ∀ᵐ ω : Ω ∂(μ : Measure Ω), Tendsto (fun i ↦ fs i ω) L (𝓝 (f ω))) :
   664      Tendsto (fun i ↦ μ.testAgainstNN (fs i)) L (𝓝 (μ.testAgainstNN f)) := by
   665    apply (ENNReal.tendsto_toNNReal (f.lintegral_lt_top_of_nnreal (μ : Measure Ω)).ne).comp
   666    exact tendsto_lintegral_nn_filter_of_le_const (Ω := Ω) μ fs_le_const fs_lim
   667

   669  If a sequence of bounded continuous non-negative functions are uniformly bounded by a constant and

   678  -/
   679  theorem tendsto_testAgainstNN_of_le_const {μ : FiniteMeasure Ω} {fs : ℕ → Ω →ᵇ ℝ≥0} {c : ℝ≥0}
